sections.label: About
sections.content: Hi, I'm Paco! I'm a Machine Learning Engineer and AI Researcher experienced in building end-to-end ML solutions with real-world industrial data. I work on predictive maintenance, time series forecasting, computer vision, and recommendation systems, using both traditional methods and deep learning (RNNs, CNNs, GNNs, Transformers). I also develop personal projects in systems programming, inference engines, and full-stack development, and I'm passionate about continuous, self-driven learning and experimenting with new technologies.
